title: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A prequel to Attack on Titan, adapted from Ryou Suzukaze's light novels: after a Titan-worshipping cult opens a gate, a baby is found alive in a Titan's vomit among the remains of its eaten mother, and is called the 'Titan's son' (Kodansha blurb via AniList; Suitable for Treatment). The boy, Kuklo, is caged and abused for years in the wealthy inner wall, then escapes with Sharle, the kind sister of his tormentor, and seeks to join the Survey Corps and face the Titans; a parallel thread follows craftsman Angel developing a device to fight them (review; MU).
life_message: Worth comes from what a person chooses to live for, not from the fear and labels others place on them.

content.note: Graphic shots of people being eaten and the aftermath; beatings of the caged Kuklo (review); Gore (AniList); Blood and Gore, Torture, Kill or Be Killed (MU).

folkways.japan: Endurance under hardship (gaman) and the group's duty to defend the walls reflect familiar Japanese shonen values.

delivery.evidence: Review calls the first volume mostly setup; no reviewer comment on preachiness (to verify).

delivery.note: Privilege is embodied in a spoiled abuser (review), while the main debate is how humanity should face the Titans.

winners_losers: Kuklo and Sharle gain freedom; the complacent elite and Titan cult are shown as the cause of suffering. Sympathy goes to the outcast.
